pages.text: $(italic)Ranged investment. Best for Ranger and Samurai.$()$(br2)Arrow damage, draw speed and ammo efficiency apply the moment you take the node; ammo save and splash effects trigger on the shot itself.

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Arrow Damage$(): the core trunk, through attributeslib:arrow_damage. It scales cleanly with the Ranger's Eagle Eye passive.$(br2)$(bold)Draw Speed$(): shorter bow charge time. At max investment bows draw almost instantly.$(br2)$(bold)Precision Branch$(): less arrow spread and more effective range, ideal for long-range Ranger play.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Barrage Branch$(): more arrows per shot (multishot-style) and a small AoE on impact.$(br2)$(bold)Marksman Capstone$(): $(bold)True Shot$(). Fully charged shots always crit, and crits deal +50% damage instead of the vanilla +50% crit.$(br2)$(bold)Next: take Draw Speed early; it changes how the bow feels in every fight.$()
